Pally

Website Instagram

Who they are

Pally is a personal AI assistant you run by texting it (iMessage / RCS / Telegram, no app to install). It remembers the people and plans in your life and handles real tasks — booking travel & dinners, follow-ups, reminders, research, phone calls, even purchases — asking approval before it acts. 'Your own personal assistant. Just text Pally.' YC-backed, SF.

What they want

  • (Angle inferred from the product + the Pally Creator Campaign brief — 'build you into a consistently viral creator', post 4×/week across 4 platforms; swap in a fuller brief anytime.)
  • Angle to model: 'I text an AI to run my life' content — AI that books things / makes calls / handles my admin, life-admin-off-my-plate, 'I fired my mental load', relatable busy-person moments that resolve with Pally doing the task.
  • Why it converts: Pally turns a text into a done task — lead with the chaos of a busy week (missed follow-ups, forgotten birthdays, admin pile-up), then show Pally just handling it.
  • Study below: the competitor cards + keyword sections show the personal-AI / AI-that-saves-time formats that go viral, so you can replicate the winners.
